content.logline: Desperate to lift a catastrophic siege, a fiercely loyal Three Kingdoms general forces his exhausted army through a deadly, snow-battered mountain pass to launch a devastating surprise attack.

cast.name: General Zhao
cast.profile: A hardened, stoic military commander of the Three Kingdoms era. His armor is battered from years of endless campaigning. He possesses an iron will and commands immense respect from his troops.
cast.motivation: To save the besieged stronghold and protect his lord's crumbling borders at any cost.
cast.flaw: He demands absolute, inhuman endurance from himself and others, risking mutiny and death by pushing his men past their breaking points.

cast.name: Lieutenant Wei
cast.profile: A younger, highly practical junior officer of the Three Kingdoms era. He bears the physical toll of the march heavily and serves as the voice of the common soldier.
cast.motivation: To keep the men in his detachment alive through an impossible winter march.
cast.flaw: He doubts the tactical validity of the suicide mission, prioritizing immediate survival over the grand strategic picture.

locations.name: The Yinping Pass
locations.description: A treacherous, high-altitude mountain gorge in the Three Kingdoms era. Jagged cliffs of dark stone are lashed by freezing winds and blinding snow, creating a deadly, seemingly impassable bottleneck.

locations.name: The Besieged City Outskirts
locations.description: A war-torn valley situated just below the mountain tree line. Smoldering siege engines, enemy tents, and thousands of hostile troops surround a battered, walled Three Kingdoms fortress.

story_arc.summary: General Zhao and his vanguard arrive at the impassable mountain range, realizing the main roads are blocked and the city will fall in days if they do not take the deadly shortcut over the peaks.
story_arc.conflict: The army must choose between certain defeat in the valley or likely death in the mountains.
story_arc.turning_point: Zhao commands the army to leave the main road and march directly into the freezing winds of the pass.

story_arc.summary: Deep in the howling blizzard of the pass, the march grinds to a halt before a sheer cliff drop. Lieutenant Wei begs Zhao to turn back as soldiers begin to freeze.
story_arc.conflict: Duty to the mission versus the raw, unyielding hostility of nature and the broken morale of the men.
story_arc.turning_point: Zhao discards his heavy iron armor and leads by example, scaling down the sheer rock face and inspiring his men to follow him into the abyss.

story_arc.summary: The surviving troops silently emerge from the mountain fog directly behind the massive enemy siege camp, launching a downhill cavalry and infantry charge.
story_arc.conflict: A starving, exhausted force must use the element of total surprise to break a superior, well-entrenched enemy army.
story_arc.turning_point: The sudden, orchestral ferocity of Zhao's charge shatters the enemy lines, forcing a total rout and saving the city.

scene_outline.goal: Commit the army to the treacherous mountain shortcut.
scene_outline.conflict: Lieutenant Wei and the troops are paralyzed by the howling winds and the sheer vertical incline of the pass.
scene_outline.turn: General Zhao draws his sword, plants it in the snow at the highest ridge, and takes the first step upward alone, forcing the army's pride to pull them forward.

scene_outline.goal: Overcome a deadly geographical obstacle that threatens to end the march.
scene_outline.conflict: A dead-end cliff face halts progress in the dark; Wei demands a retreat as men suffer severe frostbite.
scene_outline.turn: Instead of turning back, Zhao wraps himself in heavy felt and rolls down the sheer drop, surviving the fall and showing the men the brutal, desperate way forward.

scene_outline.goal: Annihilate the enemy encampment to lift the siege.
scene_outline.conflict: Zhao's forces are battered and freezing, facing a massive, heavily armed enemy force.
scene_outline.turn: Pouring out of the mountain mists like a localized storm, Zhao's vanguard strikes the unprepared enemy rear, collapsing the siege lines in a triumphant wave of destruction.
